fit_reason: Private owner selling a complete 1972 Mercury Cougar XR7 coupe.

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the green Cougar XR7 and the new paint looks great in the photos. If you want it extra sharp for buyers, we do a mobile pre-sale wash and wax and can freshen up the black rear bumper surround and spoiler. Would you like a quote?
